title: Isolation and Identification of Cancer Stem Cells by ALDH Activity Assay
author: Kwang Nickel
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bfyrjpv6

steps.title: Prepare ALDEFLUOR Assay Reagent
steps.instruction: Prepare activated ALDEFLUOR assay reagent, Bodipy-aminoacetaldehyde (BAAA), following the manufacturer's kit manual.

substeps.instruction: Make 50 µL aliquots of the reagent.
Store aliquots at -20 °C.

steps.title: Prepare and Count Cells
steps.instruction: Trypsinize UM-SCC47 cells and determine the cell count using a hemocytometer or automated cell counter.

substeps.instruction: Ensure a minimum of 3x 10^6 cells are available to prepare 6 tubes: Unstained PI only, Test (ALDH), Control (DEAB), Test (ALDH) without PI, Control (DEAB) without PI, and FITC only.

steps.title: Resuspend Cells in Assay Buffer
steps.instruction: Pellet cells by centrifugation at 250 x g for 5 min, remove supernatant, and resuspend in ALDEFLUOR assay buffer.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend cells in the two 'Test' tubes to a final concentration of 1 x 10^6 cells/ml.
Prepare the Unstained and PI tubes with 0.5 x 10^6 cells in 0.5 ml ALDEFLUOR assay buffer.

steps.title: Apply DEAB and ALDEFLUOR Reagents
steps.instruction: Add specific reagents to the control and test tubes to inhibit or activate ALDH activity.

substeps.instruction: Add 5 µL of diethylaminobenzaldehyde (DEAB) to both 'Control' tubes and close immediately to prevent evaporation of the 95% ethanol solution.
Add 5 µL of activated ALDEFLUOR reagent to both 'Test' tubes and mix by gentle vortexing or inversion.
Immediately transfer 0.5 mL of the mixture from each 'Test' tube to each 'Control' tube.

steps.title: Incubate Samples
steps.instruction: Incubate both 'Test' and 'Control' tubes for 45 min at 37 °C in the dark.

substeps.instruction: Ensure incubation does not exceed 60 min.

steps.title: Wash and Store Cells
steps.instruction: Recover cells following incubation and prepare for flow cytometry.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge cells at 250 x g for 5 min to pellet.
Remove supernatant and resuspend cells in 0.5 mL of ALDEFLUOR assay buffer.
Transfer cells to 5 ml flow tubes and store on ice or at 4 °C in the dark.

steps.title: Stain with Propidium Iodide (PI)
steps.instruction: Add 1 µL of 1 mg/ml PI to the PI, 'Test', and 'Control' tubes prior to flow analysis.

substeps.instruction: Do not add PI to the 'Test' and 'Control' FITC only tubes.

steps.title: Configure Flow Cytometer
steps.instruction: Set up the experiment and compensation on the flow cytometer (e.g., Attune NxT).

substeps.instruction: Create a new experiment and enter the experiment name.
Perform compensation setup to correct for FITC spillover into the PI channel (BL1 for FITC and BL2 for PI).
Optimize FSC (Forward Scatter) and SSC (Side Scatter) voltage and threshold settings using the Unstained sample.
Optimize fluorescence channel settings for FITC and PI using FITC and PI only samples and record compensation.

steps.title: Analyze Samples via Flow Cytometry
steps.instruction: Run samples and apply gating strategies to identify ALDH+ cells.

substeps.instruction: Set up 5 dot plots for analysis: 1) SSC-H vs. SSC-A (doublet elimination), 2) FSC-H vs. FSC-A (doublet elimination), 3) SSC-H vs. FSC-H (single cell selection), 4) SSC-H vs. PI-H (live single cell detection), 5) SSC-H vs. ALDH-H (ALDH+ selection).
Run the 'Control (DEAB)' sample and set the gate for the ALDH positive population using the rightmost edge of the stained population.
Run the ALDH 'Test' tube and collect 100,000 events within the live single cells gate.
